summary: Every requirement and ruling (R1-R6, D1, F1, F2, A1, A2) has a phase that delivered it. Each of V01-V19 has implementing work: P1 prints the promote line; P2 deletes the copy; P3 gates the suite, declares PyYAML and sets the 5-minute timeout; P4/P5 add the follow and diagnosis, with a named test per criterion (60 tests, green in the sweep); P6 updates the four KubeCoder instructions. V15 was run live in P4, and V16 waits on the operator (A1). The leftovers are B2 (transport errors crash with exit 1, a major robustness gap no criterion names), B3 (where R3 meets F1, the operator's call), S2-S4 and B1; all stay in the close-out, annotated. The one piece of mechanical residue, S1's stale sentence in Ansible docs/live-infra-access.md, is fixed in Ansible 94be15b and struck.
